function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here’s a quick rundown of places you can order a cake from—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or just a convenient delivery service:

| Category | What to Look For | Why It Might Be Right for You |
|----------|------------------|------------------------------|
| **Local Bakeries** | Search “cake shop near me” or “bakeries in [your city]” on Google Maps or Yelp. | Fresh, often custom‑made, and you can support small businesses. Many offer pickup or local delivery. |
| **Online Delivery Platforms** | Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, Postmates, SkipTheDishes, Deliveroo, etc. | Wide selection from many restaurants & bakeries; easy ordering via app; track delivery in real time. |
| **Specialty Cake Shops** | Brands like Magnolia Bakery, Sprinkles, Sweet Treats, or local artisan shops. | Known for high‑quality ingredients, creative designs, and sometimes custom orders. |
| **Big‑Box Retailers** | Costco, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Publix, Safeway. | Often have a bakery section with pre‑made cakes at competitive prices; some offer delivery through their own services or third‑party apps. |
| **Grocery Delivery Services** | Instacart, Shipt, Amazon Fresh, Peapod. | Order a cake from your favorite grocery store and have it delivered to your door. |
| **Special Occasion Sites** | CakeBoss, Bakeology, or local wedding planners. | Great for custom designs, themed cakes, or large orders for events. |
| **Subscription Boxes** | Goldbelly, The Cake Box, or local subscription services. | Receive a curated cake each month; good for trying new flavors or supporting regional bakers. |

### Tips for Choosing the Best Option

1. **Check Reviews & Ratings** – Especially for local bakeries or specialty shops.  
2. **Ask About Customization** – If you need a specific flavor, size, or design, confirm they can accommodate.  
3. **Delivery Time & Fees** – Some platforms charge extra for delivery or have minimum orders.  
4. **Allergy & Dietary Needs** – Gluten‑free, vegan, or nut‑free options may be limited in some places.  
5. **Pickup vs. Delivery** – Pickup can save money and gives you more control over timing.  

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up a few top‑rated bakeries or delivery options nearby!
